headline: Bitcoin ended the US day near $84,500 after short sellers were squeezed, as Tesla put its bitcoin gain at about $290M and reports that the US was preparing to pull staff from Gulf embassies lifted oil.

market.asOf: BTC 21 Oct 20:37 UTC (03:37 Bangkok) via investingLive; ETH 19:30 UTC via Crypto Times. SOL and Fear & Greed could not be read this run.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $84,500 as bets on a fall get squeezed
stories.summary: Bitcoin finished Wednesday's US trading day up about 1.8% at around $84,500, after touching about $84,700. Traders who had bet on a fall were forced to buy back, which added to the rise. Late in the day, reports that the US was preparing to pull some staff from embassies in the Gulf pushed oil up and US stock futures down.
points: investingLive's Americas wrap (20:37 UTC) says bitcoin "rose $1,507, or 1.82%, to $84,543." The S&P 500 rose 0.59% and the Nasdaq 1.05% (read at that time; live prices are at the top of the page).
Bitcoin's day high was $84,726.28, per Crypto Times citing TradingView.
Over 24 hours, $267.49M of trades were forced closed (liquidated) across 78,592 traders; $208.49M (78.3%) were bets on a fall, per Crypto Times citing CoinGlass.

Newsquawk reported the US State Department was preparing ordered departures of staff at Gulf embassies; a later report said non-emergency staff in Saudi Arabia only, so the scope is unclear. Brent oil rose and S&P 500 futures fell on the reports.
Bitcoin's 28-day realized volatility is near its lowest of 2026, per K33 data reported by The Block, ahead of the Fed decision on 28 Oct.

stories.title: Tesla puts its bitcoin gain at about $290M and declines merger questions
stories.summary: Tesla's third-quarter profit included a gain on paper from the rise in value of the bitcoin it holds. On Wednesday's earnings call the finance chief put it at about $290M, and the company said it would not take questions on a possible merger with SpaceX. Neither Tesla nor SpaceX sold any bitcoin in the quarter.
points: CFO Vaibhav Taneja cited "a Bitcoin mark-to-market gain of approximately 290 million"; Tesla's results put the unrealized gain at $288M.
Tesla said "we will not be addressing any questions today on a potential merger with SpaceX."
Tesla holds 11,509 BTC and SpaceX 18,712 BTC, 30,221 combined, and neither sold any in Q3, per BitcoinTreasuries.net.
Revenue was $28.05B. Electrek put Wall Street's expectation at $28.06B; Teslarati put it at $28.34B. Adjusted earnings were $0.48 a share against $0.45 expected.

sources.label: Benzinga: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings call transcript

stories.title: The first US stablecoin rule under the GENIUS Act is final, and banks are pushing back
stories.summary: The OCC, a federal bank regulator, finalized the first rule putting the GENIUS Act stablecoin law into practice. It sets requirements for stablecoin issuers it oversees. The American Bankers Association attacked it for leaving room for crypto platforms to pay rewards on stablecoins.
points: The OCC published the rule on 21 Oct. It takes effect on 18 Jan 2027.
The final rule dropped a proposed presumption against third-party arrangements, so rewards offered by platforms will be judged case by case, per The Block.
ABA CEO Rob Nichols said the rule goes against "Congress's clear intent to protect local lending." The Blockchain Association praised it.
